pyq_bad.why: wrong topic: Neolithic Burzahom burials (not Harappan)

patterns: Almost no direct PYQs on IVC society/polity here; PSCs ask burial-site matches (Lothal double burial, Sanauli, dog burials).
Trap: dog-with-human burial is asked for Burzahom (Neolithic Kashmir); in the Harappan context Ropar.
UPSC 2013 shape: 'which is NOT correct' - Harappans had no great palaces/temples, no horse chariots.
App MCQs are interpretive (polity debates, Assertion-Reason on central authority) - more analytical than APPSC's single-fact style but sound.
